content: I've made ~150 test PRs to Tau Ceti, but it would be great if all interested participants could make some more PRs, and then report back if it went well, or if the wheels fell off at some point.

The basic process is simple:

  • pick a roadmap you're interested in (or see the "Getting started: roadmaps" thread to make a new one)
  • pick an item on that roadmap that you're think Tau Ceti is ready for
  • have your favourite AI system prepare a PR making progress towards that item (either by doing new work, or taking existing material and making it ready to Tau Ceti)
  • respond to review comments, either by pushing more commits, or replying to review comments pushing back

(You can do any, all, or none of these steps using an AI, as you prefer.)
As we get started, there may be bottlenecks on review capacity, please ping me if 12 hours pass without receiving a review on a PR, and we'll try to ramp up.
